_status: BLOCKED, not authorized and not executed. Fixture, oracle and checker verified offline only; no supported executor path for a no-tool supplied-data employee case yet (see README.md, Feasibility).
customer_request: Which invoices in this ledger are overdue, and how much is outstanding?
task_input: task-input.txt (sent verbatim as the one run message; contains the ledger, rules and answer format, not the expected answer)

answer_outcomes.passed: one JSON object whose as_of, overdue set (ID, balance, days), count and three totals equal the frozen answer exactly; order, whitespace, ID case and equivalent decimal forms are ignored
answer_outcomes.failed: a well-formed completed answer with at least one semantic error (each listed)
answer_outcomes.malformed: no single JSON object, a missing field, or inexact money/days/date

reported_separately: execution or access failure (no completed run), tool use in the trace, and shutdown confirmation are run outcomes, not answer outcomes; none of them changes the answer outcome
not_established: Employee ability, data retrieval, database correctness, Discord delivery, tool isolation, server build
